input.goal: Create a single self-contained index.html: interactive full-viewport HTML5 Canvas orbital particle simulation in dark space with central glowing star, orbiting planets with moons and trails, twinkling starfield, glassmorphism HUD, and click-spawned particle bursts. Zero external dependencies.
constraints: Only one file index.html; all CSS and JS inline; no external URLs, fonts, scripts or images.
Page background and canvas clear color is #060913; html/body margin 0, overflow hidden.
One <canvas id="sim"> covering the full window (position fixed, 100vw x 100vh); on resize set canvas.width/height = innerWidth/innerHeight * devicePixelRatio and ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0).
Animation loop uses requestAnimationFrame with delta time from the timestamp (clamp dt to max 0.05 s).
Central star at canvas center drawn with ctx.createRadialGradient (white core -> #ffd27a -> #ff9a3c -> transparent) plus a corona halo whose radius pulses with a sine of time (about ±8%).
At least 6 planets, each with distinct orbital radius, angular speed, color and size; draw a faint orbit ring for each.
At least 3 moons total, each orbiting a parent planet with its own radius and speed.

Fading orbital trails: each planet keeps a history array of recent positions (about 60 points) drawn as segments with alpha decreasing toward the oldest point; trails hidden and history cleared when trails are OFF.
Background starfield of 220 stars with random positions (relative to viewport, regenerated on resize), size and twinkle phase; alpha oscillates with sin(time*speed+phase).

HUD overlay <div id="hud"> fixed top-left, glassmorphism: background rgba(255,255,255,0.08), backdrop-filter: blur(12px) (plus -webkit-backdrop-filter), border 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18), border-radius 14px, padding 14px, color #e6ecff, system-ui font, small box-shadow.
Button #btnPlay toggles pause; its text is exactly 'Pause' while running and 'Play' while paused.
Button #btnTrails toggles trails; text exactly 'Trails: ON' or 'Trails: OFF'. Default ON.
Button #btnReset resets simulation time to 0, planet/moon angles to initial values, clears trails and burst particles, and sets speed back to 1.0 (slider and readout).
Slider exactly: <input type="range" id="speed" min="0.2" max="3.0" step="0.1" value="1.0">; a <span id="speedVal"> shows live multiplier formatted like '1.0x' (one decimal + 'x') updated on input.

Stats: <span id="fps"> (integer FPS, updated about every 0.5 s), <span id="simTime"> (simulation time in seconds with 1 decimal, advances by dt*speed only while playing), <span id="particles"> (current number of active burst particles).
Clicks on the HUD must not spawn bursts (HUD stops propagation or the canvas listener only listens on the canvas).

Clicking the canvas spawns 80 particles at the click point (use clientX/clientY in CSS pixels) with random angle, random speed 60-260 px/s, random warm/cool hue; each frame velocity multiplied by Math.pow(0.92, dt*60) (damping), life decreases and alpha fades to 0; dead particles removed. Draw particles with globalCompositeOperation 'lighter' and a glow (small radial gradient or shadowBlur).
When paused, planets, moons, sim time and particles freeze, but the scene keeps rendering.

Expose window.app = { get paused(){...}, get trails(){...}, get speed(){...}, get simTime(){...}, get particleCount(){...}, planets: <array of planet objects>, moons: <array of moon objects>, stars: <starfield array> } kept in sync with live state.
Valid JavaScript, no console errors.
verify_commands: tandem:ui_test {"steps":[{"exists":"canvas#sim"},{"exists":"#hud"},{"exists":"#btnPlay"},{"exists":"#btnTrails"},{"exists":"#btnReset"},{"exists":"input#speed[type=range][min='0.2'][max='3.0'][step='0.1']"},{"js":"window.app.planets.length>=5 && window.app.moons.length>=3 && window.app.stars.length>=150"},{"js":"getComputedStyle(document.body).backgroundColor==='rgb(6, 9, 19)'"},{"expect":"moving"},{"text":"#btnPlay","match":"^Pause$"},{"click":"#btnPlay"},{"text":"#btnPlay","match":"^Play$"},{"js":"window.app.paused===true"},{"click":"#btnPlay"},{"js":"window.app.paused===false"},{"click":"#btnTrails"},{"text":"#btnTrails","match":"Trails: OFF"},{"js":"window.app.trails===false"},{"input":"#speed","value":"2.5"},{"text":"#speedVal","match":"2\\.5x"},{"js":"Math.abs(window.app.speed-2.5)<1e-6"},{"js":"(function(){var c=document.getElementById('sim');var r=c.getBoundingClientRect();c.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{clientX:r.left+200,clientY:r.top+600,bubbles:true}));return window.app.particleCount>=50 && parseInt(document.getElementById('particles').textContent)>=0;})()"},{"click":"#btnReset"},{"js":"window.app.particleCount===0 && window.app.simTime<0.5 && Math.abs(window.app.speed-1)<1e-6 && document.getElementById('speed').value==='1'"}]}
